description: Shared genre -> SuperGenre cases. Run by Mako (src/utils/__tests__/superGenreMapping.test.ts) and by the Mako Clean add-on (mediamonkey/mako-clean). The map is a list of pairs in the order Mako loads it: ordered by genre, keys lowercased and trimmed, the same shape as the 'Download for MediaMonkey' export.

cases.name: partial: genre contains a mapped key
partial: mapped key contains the genre
partial: first key in map order wins
several genres, only the second maps
several genres, the first that maps wins
exact match on an earlier genre beats a later one
a blank genre is skipped, not matched to the first key
a blank genre is skipped and the next one maps
